summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for the 2026/27 season with just one week to go, having recently welcomed some exciting new signings and one returning player to strengthen their squad for a promotion push. The Ramblers recently faced St Helens in a competitive pre-season match that showcased both sides' quality, though St Helens' clinical finishing made the difference. With three brand new kits and fresh talent on board, the club is actively seeking sponsorship opportunities ahead of what promises to be an exciting campaign.
